SPOT.definition: A point located with respect to surface features of some region.

SOOT.definition: A black colloidal substance consisting wholly or principally of amorphous carbon and used to make pigments and ink.

TOO.definition: To a degree exceeding normal or proper limits.

OPT.definition: Select as an alternative over another.
